notes:
Features

- Refreshed popup with a translucent look that matches Safari, clearer message bubbles and controls in light and dark mode

Bug Fixes

- On iPhone and iPad, the page no longer zooms in while you type in the page chat, and the keyboard opens only when you tap the input
- Popup settings wrap neatly in longer languages instead of being cut off
- The chat history menu fits within the popup
- The setup card on the home screen no longer repeats the app name
- Smaller download size

Features

- New home screen with a Safari setup card that opens step-by-step instructions for turning on the extension
- Setup steps match your device and system version on iPhone, iPad and Mac
- Redesigned account section with your token balance and one-tap Restore Purchases
- Page assistant waits until buttons and fields are ready before acting
- Page assistant checks that each step worked and tells you when a result is uncertain

Bug Fixes

- Fewer repeated clicks and duplicate entries during page tasks
- Clearer messages when the service is unavailable or an account is frozen
- Error and progress messages now appear in your language

Features

- Page assistant is much faster and uses far fewer tokens
- Better recognition of forms and options on web pages
- Click or highlight many items in one step
- See the current action under each reply, with a Stop button
- Reliably undo changes the assistant made to a page
- Fixed cases where the assistant kept thinking without finishing
- Tab, window and text tools load only when needed

Features

- Upgraded, more secure connection to our AI service for the app and Safari extension — no account needed
- Your token balance is now stored securely on our servers
- Purchased tokens are added once the purchase is confirmed; interrupted purchases resume automatically
- Latest Gemini models
- Safer display of web content and replies
- Clearer messages when the service is busy, offline, or the app needs to be opened once
- Requires iOS 16 or macOS 13 or later
- Balances from earlier versions aren't carried over automatically. If you had a balance, contact us at primaaestate.cloud

Bug Fixes

- Markdown parsing error
- The extension version number has not been updated

Features

- Add the latest model
- Supports 37 languages

Bug Fixes

- Message colors are incorrect in light mode
- The reply language is sometimes incorrect

Performance Improvements

- Reduce code inspections to improve response time

Bug Fixes

- Duplicate messages should not be saved

Features

- Add a history of task submissions
- Add the "/clear" command to clear history

Features

- Supports running Copilot scripts in a blank tab

Bug Fixes

- Unable to open the main application from the pop-up page
